bibl.title: Frammenti in vetro con decorazione a smalto da Antinoupolis.
bibl.seg: Flora Silvano, Frammenti in vetro con decorazione a smalto da Antinoupolis.
bibl.note: The glass fragments were found during clandestine excavations carried out in Antinoupolis after the Egyptian revolution of January 2011. They belonged to a colourless freeblown glass bottle (Isings form 103) with enamelled decoration on the globular body. The shape of the bottle and the technique of decoration suggest a date to the III-IV century AD.
